full_protocol.assumptions: Exact products over conditions, calls independent. Each choice call is invalid with the stated rate, else as the chooser's per-call probabilities; a condition with fewer than 27 valid answers voids the unit. TR-RR has no premise condition, no tie condition and no reader probe: its conditions are choices among plans with no reader, the kind TR8's premise conditions check, so here they are the outcome, not presupposed. Probe calls (30 per condition) only where numbers are computed; the probe restates the plans' told numbers and the formula and asks each plan's number. Under the law's model it ranks first as an independent call of the same noisy counts; every rival that can compute computes it right, so its probe ranks as the counts do, whatever input it misweighs, disbelieves or replaces in its choice; H1, which does not compute where it must, probes its own counts; G1's probe computes a loss-blind count, S1's. Refusals are counted with invalid answers here. The guard reports a bridge otherwise supported contradicted where a supported condition's probe ranks another plan first in at least 23 of 30; such a hit beside an unresolved bridge is reported with no verdict (within unresolved). The label (miscomputed where the probe ranks a modal chosen plan first in at least 15 of 30; where several are modal, any of them, the union exact) is split exactly over the choice calls for the law; for a rival, approximately, its pick taken as the modal plan.
